installGuideIntro.message: Follow these steps to set up your first timer and understand key controls.

installGuideStep1.message: Pin Auto Tab Timer to your toolbar so it is always one click away.

installGuideStep2.message: Open the tab you want to manage, then open the extension popup.

installGuideStep3.message: Enter hours, minutes, and seconds, then click Start Timer.

installGuideStep4.message: Choose completion action: Close tab or Notify me only.

installGuideStep5.message: Use Pause, Resume, Reset, or Cancel from the active timer card as needed.

installGuideStep6.message: Open Settings to choose your default completion action and notification behavior.

installGuideTip1.message: 00:00:00 is invalid. The extension shows an inline error and prevents start.

installGuideTip2.message: Minutes and seconds are normalized to 0..59, and hours are normalized to 0..999.

installGuideTip3.message: Notify me only always sends a notification and keeps the tab open.

installGuideTip4.message: Close tab action can send notifications based on your notification toggle.

installGuidePrivacy.message: No account is required. Settings and timer state are stored in your browser extension storage.
